name: Burpee
setup: Clear a space roughly two metres long and stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
instructions: Squat down and place both hands on the floor just inside your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor for a full push-up.
Push back up and jump your feet forward to your hands.
Drive through your heels and jump vertically, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly with bent knees and move straight into the next rep.

name: Squat Thrust (Half Burpee)
setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms by your sides.
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump both feet back into a high plank position.
Immediately jump your feet back to your hands.
Stand up tall to finish the rep. No push-up and no jump — keep the pace brisk.

name: Sprawl
setup: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
instructions: Drop your hands to the floor and shoot your legs back, letting your hips sink toward the ground while your chest stays off the floor.
Keep your head up and back flat at the bottom.
Snap your feet back underneath your hips in one explosive motion.
Return to standing and repeat.

name: Jumping Jacks
setup: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
instructions: Jump your feet out to just wider than shoulder width while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together while bringing your arms back to your sides.
Stay light on the balls of your feet and keep a steady rhythm.

name: High Knees
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees.
instructions: Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in opposition to your legs as if sprinting.
Stay on the balls of your feet, keep your chest up and core braced.
Aim for fast turnover rather than height once warm.

name: Butt Kick Run
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
instructions: Run on the spot, flicking each heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your knees pointing down and your thighs roughly vertical.
Pump your arms and keep ground contact light and quick.

name: Skater Jumps
setup: Clear a space about two metres wide. Stand on your right leg with your left foot off the floor.
instructions: Bound sideways to your left, landing softly on your left foot with your knee tracking over your toes.
Swing your right leg behind your left and your arms across your body like a speed skater.
Pause briefly to control the landing, then bound back to the right.
Keep your chest up and sink into each landing to absorb the impact.

name: Alternating Jump Lunges
setup: Step into a lunge: front knee over ankle, back knee just above the floor.
instructions: Drive through your front foot and jump straight up.
Switch legs in the air and land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Keep your torso upright and absorb each landing through bent knees.
Alternate legs every rep at a controlled, rhythmic pace.

name: Plank Jacks
setup: Set up in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet together.
instructions: Keeping your core braced and hips level, jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together. That is one rep.
Do not let your hips bounce or sag — the plank stays rigid throughout.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
setup: Set up in a high plank with feet slightly wider than hip width for stability.
instructions: Lift your right hand and tap your left shoulder, then return it to the floor.
Repeat with the left hand to the right shoulder.
Brace your core so your hips stay square to the floor — no rocking side to side.
Alternate hands at a slow, controlled tempo.

name: Bear Crawl
setup: Clear a path of five to ten metres.
Start on all fours with hands under shoulders, knees under hips and hovering a few centimetres off the floor.
instructions: Crawl forward by moving your right hand and left foot together, then your left hand and right foot.
Keep your knees low, back flat and hips level — imagine balancing a cup of water on your lower back.
Take small, quiet steps and keep your core braced.
Crawl backward the same way to return.

name: Crab Walk
setup: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips off the floor.
instructions: Walk forward by moving your right hand and left foot together, then the opposite pair.
Keep your hips lifted throughout — do not let them sag to the floor.
Travel the set distance, then reverse direction.

name: Wall Sit
setup: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet about 60 cm out from it, hip-width apart.
instructions: Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your knees over your ankles, back pressed into the wall and hands off your thighs.
Breathe steadily and hold for the prescribed time.

name: Pogo Hops
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on hips or by your sides.
instructions: Bounce vertically off the balls of your feet with minimal knee bend, like a pogo stick.
Keep ground contact as short as possible and use your ankles as springs.
Stay tall — no folding at the hips.

name: Lateral Shuffle
setup: Mark out five to ten metres. Start in an athletic stance: hips back, knees bent, chest up.
instructions: Shuffle sideways with quick, low steps, pushing off the trailing leg.
Never let your feet cross or click together.
Stay low the whole way, touch the line, and shuffle back the other direction.

name: Shuttle Run
setup: Place two markers 10–20 metres apart on a flat, non-slip surface.
instructions: Sprint from the start line to the far marker and touch the line with your hand or foot.
Decelerate under control, turn, and sprint back.
Repeat for the prescribed number of lengths.
Focus on fast, choppy steps into each turn and a hard drive out of it.

name: Hill Sprint
setup: Find a hill with a moderate gradient (5–10%) and 30–60 metres of clear run.
Warm up thoroughly with jogging and drills before the first sprint.
instructions: Sprint up the hill at near-maximal effort, driving your knees and pumping your arms.
Lean slightly into the hill from the ankles, not the waist.
Walk back down slowly — the walk-down is part of your recovery.
Repeat for the prescribed number of efforts.

name: Stair Run
setup: Find a staircase of at least 20 steps with a handrail available for safety.
instructions: Run up the stairs one step at a time, driving through each foot and pumping your arms.
Keep your eyes on the steps ahead, not your feet.
Walk back down to recover, then repeat.
Progress to two steps at a time only when confident.

name: Shadow Boxing
setup: Stand in a boxing stance: non-dominant foot forward, hands up at chin height, elbows tucked.
instructions: Throw combinations of jabs, crosses, hooks and uppercuts at an imaginary opponent.
Rotate your hips and pivot your feet with each punch — power comes from the ground up.
Stay light on your feet, moving and slipping between combinations.
Keep your hands returning to guard after every punch.

name: Bird Dog
setup: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips, spine neutral.
instructions: Extend your right arm forward and left leg back until both are level with your torso.
Hold for two to three seconds without letting your hips rotate or your back arch.
Return to the start under control and repeat on the opposite side.
Move slowly — the goal is stability, not speed.

name: V-Up
setup: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
instructions: Simultaneously lift your legs and torso, reaching your hands toward your toes so your body forms a V.
Keep your legs as straight as possible and lift from your abs, not your neck.
Lower back down with control, stopping just before your heels and shoulders touch the floor.

name: Hollow Body Hold
setup: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
instructions: Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders, arms and legs a few centimetres off the ground.
Your body should form a shallow banana shape, rigid from fingertips to toes.
Hold for the prescribed time while breathing shallowly.
If your lower back lifts off the floor, raise your legs higher or bend your knees to regress.

name: Battle Rope Alternating Waves
setup: Anchor the rope at its midpoint and hold one end in each hand.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet shoulder-width apart and enough slack in the rope.
instructions: Whip your arms up and down in alternation, sending continuous waves down each side of the rope.
Keep your knees bent, core braced and torso steady — the arms do the whipping.
Maintain wave height and speed for the full work interval.

name: Battle Rope Slams
setup: Anchor the rope at its midpoint and hold one end in each hand.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
instructions: Extend up onto your toes as you raise both rope ends overhead.
Slam the ropes into the floor as hard as possible, dropping into a quarter squat as you do.
Immediately rise and repeat in one fluid rhythm.

name: Backward Sled Drag
setup: Attach a strap or handles to the sled and face it, holding the handles with arms extended.
instructions: Walk backward with short, quick steps, keeping tension on the strap the whole time.
Sit slightly into your hips and keep your chest up.
Drive each step through the ball of the foot and into the heel.
Drag for the prescribed distance.

name: Wall Ball Shot
setup: Stand an arm's length from a sturdy wall with a target roughly 3 metres up.
Hold a medicine ball at chest height with elbows tucked.
instructions: Squat to full depth, keeping the ball at your chest.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball at the wall target as you reach full extension.
Catch the ball as it rebounds and absorb it straight into the next squat.
Keep a smooth, continuous rhythm throughout the set.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing in, feet shoulder-width apart.
instructions: Squat to at least parallel, keeping your elbows up and chest tall.
Drive up hard out of the squat and use the momentum to press both dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms with biceps by your ears, then lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders as you descend into the next rep.

name: Devil Press
setup: Place two dumbbells on the floor shoulder-width apart and stand behind them.
instructions: Grip the dumbbells and perform a burpee, lowering your chest between them.
Jump your feet back in, then in one motion swing both dumbbells between your legs and overhead.
Finish standing tall with arms locked out overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to the floor under control and repeat.

name: Man Maker
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
instructions: Squat down, place the dumbbells on the floor and jump back to a plank on the handles.
Perform a push-up, then row the right dumbbell to your hip, then the left.
Jump your feet back in, clean the dumbbells to your shoulders and stand.
Finish with a push press overhead, then lower and repeat.

name: Two-Hand Kettlebell Swing
setup: Place a kettlebell about 30 cm in front of your feet.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the handle with both hands.
instructions: Hike the bell back between your legs like a centre snap.
Snap your hips forward explosively, squeezing your glutes to float the bell to chest height.
Let the bell swing back down and re-hinge — arms stay relaxed, the hips do all the work.
Keep your spine neutral and heels planted throughout.
On the final rep, guide the bell safely back to the floor between your feet.

name: Double Unders
setup: Size the rope: standing on its middle, the handles should reach your armpits.
Stand tall with elbows tucked to your ribs and hands slightly in front of your hips.
instructions: Jump slightly higher than a normal skip and spin the rope twice under your feet per jump.
Generate speed from the wrists, not the arms or shoulders.
Keep your jumps vertical with a tight, hollow body — avoid donkey-kicking or piking.
Build up with single-single-double rhythms before attempting consecutive doubles.

name: Assault Bike Intervals
setup: Adjust the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Grip the handles and place feet on the pedals.
instructions: Drive the pedals and handles together, pushing and pulling with your arms as your legs pump.
Work at near-maximal effort for the prescribed interval.
Spin easily during recovery periods — keep the legs moving.
Maintain an upright torso; avoid collapsing over the handles as you fatigue.

name: Rowing Sprint Intervals
setup: Strap your feet in and set the damper between 4 and 6.
Grip the handle, sit tall at the catch with shins vertical.
instructions: Drive in sequence: legs, then hips, then arms; reverse the order on the recovery.
Row at maximal sustainable power for the prescribed sprint interval.
Paddle lightly during recovery intervals without letting your form collapse.
Aim for consistent split times across all intervals.

name: Ski Erg
setup: Stand facing the machine, feet hip-width apart, and grip both handles overhead.
instructions: Pull both handles down in a powerful arc, hinging at the hips and crunching your torso.
Finish with hands past your hips and a strong hip hinge.
Let the handles ride back up as you extend tall, then repeat in rhythm.
Drive with your lats and core, not just your arms.

name: Box Step-Over
setup: Stand side-on or facing a stable box at knee height or below.
instructions: Step up onto the box with your full foot, drive through that leg and step over to the other side.
Step down softly one foot at a time.
Continue over and back, alternating the leading leg.
Stay tall and avoid pushing off the trailing foot.

name: Agility Ladder In-In-Out-Out
setup: Lay an agility ladder flat on a non-slip surface and stand at one end.
instructions: Step into the first square with your right foot, then your left.
Step out wide to either side of the next square: right foot out, left foot out.
Repeat the in-in-out-out pattern down the full ladder, staying on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms pumping and eyes ahead, not on your feet.

name: Sandbag Shouldering
setup: Stand over a sandbag with feet just wider than shoulder width.
instructions: Squat down with a flat back and wrap your arms under the bag.
Deadlift it to your lap, then in one powerful hip extension pull it up and onto one shoulder.
Stand fully, then lower the bag back to the floor under control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

name: Suitcase Carry
setup: Place a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell beside one foot.
Deadlift it to standing with a neutral spine.
instructions: Walk the prescribed distance carrying the weight in one hand like a suitcase.
Stay perfectly upright — do not lean toward or away from the weight.
Keep your shoulder packed and core braced against the side-bend.
Swap hands and repeat in the other direction.

name: Swimming, Freestyle
setup: Use a pool with lane space; wear goggles and a swim cap if preferred.
instructions: Swim front crawl: alternate overhead arm strokes with a steady flutter kick.
Keep your body long and horizontal, rotating slightly with each stroke.
Breathe to the side every two or three strokes.
Swim the prescribed distance or time at a sustainable effort.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
setup: Sit on the floor with your front leg bent at 90 degrees in front of you and your back leg bent at 90 degrees to the side.
instructions: Keeping both heels planted, rotate your knees together across your body until the legs swap positions.
Sit tall through the movement — avoid slumping or supporting yourself heavily on your hands.
Pause in each position and breathe into the hip stretch.
Continue switching sides slowly and with control.

name: Cat-Cow
setup: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
instructions: Inhale and let your belly drop while lifting your chest and tailbone (cow).
Exhale and round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat).
Move slowly between the two positions, segment by segment.
Match each movement to your breath.

name: Open Book Thoracic Rotation
setup: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked at 90 degrees, arms extended together in front of your chest.
instructions: Keeping your knees glued together on the floor, sweep your top arm up and over to the opposite side like opening a book.
Follow your hand with your eyes and let your upper back rotate.
Pause and breathe at your end range, then return slowly.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: Couch Stretch
setup: Kneel in front of a wall or couch. Place one shin vertically up the wall with the knee tucked into the corner, and step the other foot forward into a half-kneel.
instructions: Squeeze the glute of the back leg and gently push your hips forward.
Raise your torso as upright as the stretch allows, keeping your ribs down.
Hold and breathe for the prescribed time, then switch legs.
Back off if you feel pinching in the knee or lower back.

name: Downward Dog to Cobra
setup: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
instructions: Push your hips up and back into downward dog, pressing your heels toward the floor.
Hold for a breath, then shift forward, dropping your hips toward the floor as your chest pulls through your arms into cobra.
Lift your chest, keeping hips low and legs relaxed.
Flow smoothly back to downward dog and repeat with your breath.
